description: This file manages temporary object directories in a Git repository. It includes functions for creating, destroying, and migrating temporary object directories, handling environment setup, and managing repository object storage during operations like packing and migration.

classes.name: tmp_objdir
classes.description: Structure representing a temporary object directory, including repository reference, path buffer, environment variables, previous source, and destroy flag.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_free(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a tmp_objdir instance.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_destroy(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Destroys the temporary object directory and restores repository state if needed.

methods.name: void remove_tmp_objdir(void)
methods.description: Ensures cleanup of the temporary object directory on program exit.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_discard_objects(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Removes object files from the temp directory but keeps the top-level directory.

methods.name: void env_append(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Appends a new value to an environment variable, quoting if necessary.

methods.name: void env_replace(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Replaces the environment variable with a new value.

methods.name: int setup_tmp_objdir(const char * root)
methods.description: Creates a subdirectory named 'pack' within the given root directory.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_create(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory for a repository with specified prefix.

methods.name: int pack_copy_priority(const char * name)
methods.description: Determines the copying priority of pack files based on their filename suffix.

methods.name: int pack_copy_cmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Comparison function for pack files based on their priority.

methods.name: int read_dir_paths(struct string_list * out,const char * path)
methods.description: Reads directory entries into a string list, ignoring hidden entries.

methods.name: int migrate_paths(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Migrates object files from source to destination directory.

methods.name: int migrate_one(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Handles migration of a single object file or directory during migration.

methods.name: int is_loose_object_shard(const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a filename corresponds to a loose object shard (two hex digits).

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_migrate(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Migrates the objects from the temporary directory to the main object directory.

methods.name: const char ** tmp_objdir_env(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Returns the environment variables for the temp object directory.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Adds the temporary object directory as an alternate object database.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,int will_destroy)
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the temporary one.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb(void)
methods.description: Restores the previous primary object database.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
methods.description: Reapplies the primary object database, adjusting paths accordingly.

ctags.signature: (struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)

ctags.signature: (struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
